purpose: Five remixed profiles for owner-led conversation and UI review on :8893.
execution_status: Not run; manual review inputs only, not automated expected results.
instructions: Use one fresh visit per profile; do not resume a different profile's saved information.
Send only the opening first. Use the answer bank as the chat asks; do not paste the whole profile.
There is no required question order. Rephrase naturally or use matching buttons.
Try the optional turn once at its stated moment. A correction supersedes the earlier answer.
For anything unspecified, say I don't know or leave it for later; do not invent facts.
All people, clinics, pharmacy names and Example medicines are fictional. These runs assess the UI and conversation, not real provider/drug matches.
All five retain ZIP 34102 from the original corpus so geography does not dominate the comparison between runs.

answer_bank.answer: This is for me.
I turn 65 in March 2027.
I'm on COBRA. I don't have insurance from a current job.
My job and its active employee insurance ended October 31, 2026. COBRA started after that.
The COBRA paperwork says April 30, 2027.
I haven't applied for Medicare and don't have Parts A or B.
As soon as I'm eligible. I need help understanding the timing.
Dr. Rivera at Example Clinic in Naples. That's the only doctor I want to keep.
Example Three. It's a tablet, but I don't know the strength.
I use Example Pharmacy in Naples, in person. I don't know the quantity or days supply right now.
I only need routine care locally.
Lower monthly payments and keeping my doctor both matter. I haven't ranked them.
I'm new to all of this. One small explanation at a time would help.

optional_turn.when: After the first explanation of the coverage paths
optional_turn.message: Wait, is Medicare Advantage something I buy in addition to Original Medicare?
optional_turn.observe: Does it resolve the confusion in plain language, then return naturally to the practical discussion?

ui_focus: Eligibility explanation arrives before a demand for a preferred date; COBRA stays distinct from current-job coverage.
Unknown medicine strength stays open without trapping the chat or inventing a value.
Doctor and medicine acknowledgments feel timely without recurring in every reply.
